## ReadRefusal

| constructor | fields | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ReadRefusal.unknownHead` | `name` | A call whose head is a reserved name with no `Eff` reading in that position (`Cause.fail` outside a cause, `Effect.whileLoop` outside its suspend). |
| `ReadRefusal.unknownIdent` | `name` | An identifier that is no binder, no reserved name, and no value row. |
| `ReadRefusal.arity` | `head` | A row called with an argument list its row table does not print. |
| `ReadRefusal.binder` | `expected` | A lambda, `const` or `step` parameter that is not the binder due at that position. |
| `ReadRefusal.shape` | `what` | Any other form the printer never emits; `what` names the position. |
| `ReadRefusal.negative` | `value` | A negative integer literal. |
| `ReadRefusal.unsupportedStmt` | — | A statement form the printer never emits. |
| `ReadRefusal.annotation` | `site` | A binder, return or local annotation the raw printer never emits; `site` names the position. This is not `arity` (an argument list the row table does not print) and not `unsupportedStmt` (a statement form with no reading): a consumer routing on the alphabet must be able to tell "annotated, not admitted here" from "wrong shape". |

## PrintRefusal

| constructor | fields | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PrintRefusal.internalAction` | `name` | — |
| `PrintRefusal.layerRef` | `target` | — |
| `PrintRefusal.unsafeName` | `spelling` | A row table carries an unsafe spelling (colliding with binders or reserved heads). |
| `PrintRefusal.typeSpelling` | `text` | A legacy target type has no structural reading in the supported profile. Named by a row's spelling, it is also the refusal of an operation's type arguments (`printCall`): one of them has no printed form, or the row's call cannot carry them on its head (`withHeadTypes`). |
| `PrintRefusal.payloadClass` | `tag why` | An error payload class the module cannot declare, named by its tag (decisions row 120). |
| `PrintRefusal.binderTerm` | `spelling` | An operation that carries a binder term on a row whose printed form is no call, named by the row's spelling: a value row has no argument list to carry the term's function (`withFunction`). No native row is such a row: the eight term rows are call rows, and each prints its term (the state plan's T5). |
| `PrintRefusal.callbackRequirement` | `path` | An invocation whose programs need a service that the printed parameter's type cannot carry, at the invocation's path (decisions row 340; Codex's HO3-REQ-01): the header closes a parameter's requirement row as `never`, so tsgo refuses the call. Kept until the target can bind a requirement variable on the header. |
| `PrintRefusal.invocation` | `definition` | An invocation with programs of a definition that the signature lacks, or that takes no program, by the definition's position in its block (`printInvoke`): the row call invokes a definition that takes no program. |
| `PrintRefusal.emptyBlock` | — | A definition block that holds no definition: it would print as its main program alone, and read back as it (`printModuleWith`). |
| `PrintRefusal.bodies` | `position` | A definition block whose declarations and bodies differ in number, from the definition at this position on (`printDefsWith`). The checker refuses such a block too. |
| `PrintRefusal.serviceName` | `name` | A name that two definitions of a block with a service share, or that two of the names its services declare share, a key and a layer among them (`serviceFault`). |
| `PrintRefusal.strayMethod` | `definition service` | A definition that is a method of a service the block does not declare, by the definition and the service it names (`serviceFault`). |
| `PrintRefusal.service` | `name` | A service that does not print, by its name: its initial program is missing, takes a request or a program; it has no method, two with one name, or one whose name is no plain key; or its name or its layer's is a definition's or carries a layer path (`serviceFaultOf`). |
| `PrintRefusal.serviceMethod` | `service method` | A method of a service that does not print, by the service and the method: its definition is missing, or its request is not the service's state and the method's arguments (`serviceFaultOf`). |
| `PrintRefusal.declarations` | `services types` | An application that declares services or named types, by how many of each, refused at the root by the certified faces (`Api.targetSupport`). They print at the rows' signature alone, which types a declared service code at its built-in carrier, so the printed types could differ from the certificate's silently. Conservative: an unused declaration is refused too. Kept until emission checks at the application's whole typing signature (R1). |

## ClassRefusal

| constructor | fields | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ClassRefusal.notIdentifier` | — | The tag is not a TypeScript identifier, so no class can be named by it. |
| `ClassRefusal.collides` | — | The tag collides with a name the module already binds: an import (`Data`, `Effect`, …), an atom or row of its prelude, a reserved head, a builtin, or one of its own declarations. |
| `ClassRefusal.fieldsDiffer` | — | Two payload types under one tag with different fields: one class cannot declare both. |
| `ClassRefusal.construction` | — | A construction of the payload type outside the class form (`Classes.classTag?`): `_tag` is not its first field, its first name and the tag's literal, or a name repeats `_tag`. |
| `ClassRefusal.unreadable` | — | The class's printed declaration does not read back to its fields (`ClassTable.checkedDecl`): a field type TypeScript spells like another (`number`), or a field naming another class. |
